summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi CRUS 2x Daily ETF (CRUC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Cirrus Logic, Inc. (NASDAQ: CRUS), which designs and supplies low-power, high-precision mixed-signal processing components, including audio codecs, amplifiers, and haptic drivers for smartphones and consumer electronics. CRUC was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
